The garment manufacturing industry is highly competitive and requires a company to pay attention to all aspects of the production process in order to succeed. From sourcing, production planning, and scheduling to inventory management, quality control, and delivery of completed products to customers, there is much to be considered. As a company grows, streamlining and automating these processes becomes a priority in order to remain efficient and cost-effective.

This is where garment manufacturing ERP software can make a difference. A garment ERP system is an enterprise resource planning solution that allows a garment manufacturer to integrate and centrally manage its business operations, including production, inventory, purchasing, sales, and financial accounting.

For manufacturers that want to optimize their business processes and become more productive, Vellko ERP is an ERP-centric platform that can help you organize and scale your business.

What Is Garment Manufacturing ERP Software?

Garment manufacturing ERP software is designed to facilitate end-to-end processes involved in manufacturing of apparels. The applications are also capable enough so that you can manage all the threads of communication and deal with accurate, reliable information flowing throughout your organization.

As a garment manufacturer, you are involved in a complex supply chain that includes purchasing of fabric, cutting, stitching, finishing, inspection, packing, and shipping activities. You can use different spreadsheets, databases, and software applications to perform these tasks.

Depending on the system's capabilities, garment manufacturing ERP software may support:

  • Production planning and scheduling
  • Fabric, trims, and raw material inventory
  • Purchase and supplier management
  • Work orders and production tracking
  • Quality control and inspection
  • Order management and delivery tracking
  • Costing and financial reporting
  • Business performance analysis

By connecting these functions, manufacturers can make informed decisions and manage operations more efficiently.

Common Challenges in the Garment Manufacturing Industry

1. Inventory Management Problems

Garment manufacturers work with various garment materials, colors, sizes, accessories, and other details. However, warehousing and production planning may become complex tasks for the companies due to the heterogeneity of materials and other factors.

The lack of materials or overstocking may result in unplanned expenditures or production delays. Both situations can be avoided with the help of ERP systems, which enable effective control of materials and overview of their quantities in warehouses and production departments.

2. Production Planning Difficulties

The meeting of customer deadlines requires a tight coordination of cutting, stitching, finishing, and packing departments. A delay in one department has a cascading effect on the subsequent process. Finally, an ERP system can help in organizing the production and tracking the progress of various production orders. An ERP system assists in spotting and managing bottlenecks in the production process.

3. Rising Manufacturing Costs

Labor, fabric, accessories, electricity, transportation, and wastage are some of the many garment production costs. Tracking the costs in different categories is not ideal for managing and monitoring costs.

Cloud-based ERP systems can store the necessary cost data centrally and manage overheads efficiently.

4. Limited Production Visibility

Managers are highly dependent on timely information regarding completed and ongoing work, orders, materials used, and delays. In the absence of readily available data, management decisions may be based on obsolete information.

An integrated Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system can help in visualizing the company’s underlying operations more transparently, particularly if the relevant modules are adopted.

5. Quality Control Challenges

Keeping the quality of the garments under control is of paramount importance for the satisfaction of the customers and the prosperity of the business. Defects, rework, and scraps directly impact the financial performance of the business.

An ERP system can help in quality inspection, recording, and reporting of defects, and tracking of defective items.

Key Features to Look for in Garment Manufacturing ERP Software

The organization must first analyze its specific requirements to select the most appropriate ERP system. The following functionalities are particularly suitable for clothing companies:

Production Planning and Control

This function allows the manufacturer to manage the production schedule, plan resources and track the production process. The software helps the company stay on top of the manufacturing process and ensures that all deadlines are respected.

Fabric and Raw Material Management

Garments are products made of fabric. An ERP system should be able to manage inventory, track fabric and accessory utilization, and create purchase orders based on the planned production schedule.

Purchase and Supplier Management

Efficient buying helps to avoid shortages and control costs of procurement. ERP system centralizes purchase orders, suppliers, and purchasing history to facilitate the cooperation of both purchasing and production departments.

Order Management

Apparel companies may receive dozens of orders for garments, which vary in style, quantity, size, color, and delivery time. Organization of the centralized order management helps track all the details and manage the next steps in production.

Quality Management

Quality Management functions assist in recording inspection results, defect tracking, and monitoring of quality issues. These functions help ensure continual improvement and contribute to achieving high standards of quality.

Reporting and Business Insights

Well-written reports assist in conveying the amount of inventory, production, orders, and costs to managers. ERP reporting makes information readily available and accessible to plan and run a business.

Benefits of Garment Manufacturing ERP Software

Implementing suitable ERP software can provide several business benefits.

Reduced Manual Work

Centralized documents and automated records can make manual work redundant and lessen the possibility of errors.

Improved Inventory Control

With records of the materials at one’s disposal, a firm can have a clearer vision of their material needs and prevent occurrences of wastage.

Better Production Coordination

Having orderly records of production can facilitate teamwork and prevent production freezes that may result in late deliveries.

More Effective Cost Monitoring

Centralized purchasing, inventory, and production data can help in gaining a better understanding of the manufacturing costs.

Improved Customer Service

The ability to deliver accurate information and better organization can assist in providing more reliable customer service and fulfilling commitments.

Greater Management Visibility

The report feature can enable the owner and managers to stay informed about the company and identify areas for improvement.

The actual results will depend on the specific ERP features, the quality of data, employee training, and the degree of integration into the company’s operations.

How to Choose the Best ERP Software for Garment Manufacturing

Before investing in an ERP solution, manufacturers must identify their needs

Understand your workflows: Create a system that covers everything, starting with receiving customer orders, buying of materials, production, inspection, packing, and dispatch.

Check garment-specific features: if the system offers the required sets of features related to style-wise inventory management, color and size variations, fabric consumption, production stages, and order-wise costing (if needed).

Evaluate customization options: Ensure that it is possible to customize the system according to your business needs and eliminate unnecessary modules and features.

Review reporting capabilities: Define the reports related to production, inventory, purchasing, and finances that your managers and directors should be able to access.

Consider implementation and support: Inquire about data migration assistance, employee training, onboarding support, technical help, and system maintenance.

Request a practical demonstration: Request a demonstration of the software, and ensure that it is possible to see how the system will handle your typical orders, for example, an order that involves several sizes of a garment, or a production run that utilizes different fabrics and accessories.

These criteria should be used to assess Vellko ERP and understand if it is the right choice for your business.

The Future of Garment Manufacturing with ERP Software

The garment manufacturing industry is becoming increasingly competitive. Customers are demanding high quality, shorter lead times, and lower prices, and manufacturers must find ways to operate more efficiently in order to meet these expectations. ERP software can help manufacturers achieve these goals by unifying business information, standardizing processes, and providing key reports.

In addition, as manufacturers become more comfortable with the digitalization of their operations, additional integrated technologies, such as barcode systems, production scheduling and demand forecasting, can help support their needs. Companies should assess what tools are available in their ERP software, and what technologies they may need to invest in separately.

For garment manufacturers that are looking to scale their operations, investing in the right ERP software is a critical decision, and can be the catalyst that propels their business forward.

Conclusion

Garment manufacturing is a multifaceted process involving a number of activities in procurement, inventory management, production, quality assurance, and distribution. These functions should be appropriately controlled and coordinated to reduce costs, ensure quality, and satisfy customers’ demands.

ERP system for garment manufacturing facilitates information centralization, enhances business communication, and improves decision-making processes. However, it is necessary to thoroughly explore each module, apparel industry-specific features, and the company’s ability to implement and adapt to the solution to understand how ERP systems benefit garment manufacturing companies.

Therefore, it is critical to investigate the Vellko ERP’s functions, examine the application’s advantages and weaknesses, and recognize whether this solution fits the organization’s business needs and production capabilities. If your manufacturing company strives to improve its production process, analyze the given ERP system and evaluate its capacity to meet your garment manufacturing company’s demands.

The solution supports multiple processes involved in apparel production. In addition, it offers industry-specific functions and can help in enhancing the communication process between stakeholders while standardizing business procedures. However, it is not enough to consider one ERP option when searching for the best-fit solution. It is essential to ensure that the selected system will support the company’s growth and development in the long run.
